title: The Forehead Test That Reveals Your True Personality

vo.en: Draw a letter Q on your forehead.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's index finger reaching toward his forehead against a dark background.

vo.en: Use your index finger and do it very fast. Don't think.

visual.description: Fast motion shots of a vintage stopwatch ticking and a finger tracing a shape in the air.

vo.en: Which way does the tail point? To your left or right?

visual.description: A spinning compass needle and a man looking confused toward a directional street sign.

vo.en: Wait, because this reveals a creepy truth about your secret brain.

visual.description: A high-tech digital animation of a human brain glowing with neural pathways.

vo.en: If it points right, you’re an authentic soul who stays true to yourself.

visual.description: A man standing alone on a high mountain peak overlooking a vast forest.

vo.en: If it points left, you’re a social chameleon who adapts to any room.

visual.description: A macro shot of a chameleon's eye followed by a blurred time-lapse of a city crowd.

vo.en: You’re likely an expert at reading people and hiding your true feelings.

visual.description: An intense close-up of a man's eye and hands holding playing cards at a table.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment your direction. To start, simply
